sections.title: Added
items: Review simulator devices by name, OS version, and status. Select individual devices or removable Xcode runtimes and review the selection before removing them.

sections.title: Changed
items: Hover over or click the info icon on a cleanup row to see what happens after removal and how the item is removed.
The Andromeda galaxy in the menu bar opens a storage drawer that slides in from the display’s right edge.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Runtime lists match mounted simulator images to their backing system assets and show the on-disk size where available.
Clicking the menu-bar icon a second time closes the storage drawer.

sections.title: Added
items: Open Andromeda from the menu bar to see free space across mounted drives and the startup disk’s usage and history.
Open Tools from the sidebar or menu bar to find App Leftovers, Uninstaller, Downloads, Duplicate Finder, Similar Images, Large and Old Files, System Junk, and Time Machine Snapshots.
AI Clutter reviews AI app caches and logs, individual LM Studio GGUF files, and models listed by the local Ollama service.
Mail Attachments reviews local downloads with verified matching copies in Apple Mail. Trash Bins reviews selected files on the startup disk and supported external drives before permanent deletion.
Maintenance Tasks brings together startup disk verification, Spotlight reindexing, DNS cache flushing, and links to Apple Mail and Disk Utility. Spotlight and DNS use the updated optional helper.

sections.title: Changed
items: Overview groups cleanup suggestions by folder type. Expand a row to see what uses space and open its review.
Worth knowing starts collapsed, and scan coverage explains unreadable locations and unaccounted space.

sections.title: Changed
items: Overview groups cleanup suggestions by folder type under Safe to remove and Review first. Expand a row to see what uses space and how to review it.
Worth knowing starts collapsed. Expand it to see the storage explanations.
Scan coverage explains why some locations can stay unreadable after granting Full Disk Access and what can contribute to unaccounted space.

sections.title: Changed
items: The first Scan my Mac button uses Andromeda’s blue-to-purple gradient and expands into the scan checklist while scanning starts.

sections.title: Added
items: Public Beta has a blue galaxy icon with PUBLIC and BETA badges. Private Beta has a violet galaxy icon with a tilted grid and PRIVATE and BETA badges.

sections.title: Changed
items: Open What’s New from the link beside Software Updates.

sections.title: Added
items: Opt in to public beta updates in Settings → Updates on public builds.
What’s New groups changes into the releases published for your build’s channel.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Update checks use the feed configured by the signed app, even when an older DiskPlain beta saved a different feed in shared preferences.

sections.title: Added
items: Settings → Updates shows the installed build’s release channel so you can tell a private beta from a public release.

sections.title: Changed
items: DiskPlain is now Andromeda, with a blue-to-purple galaxy icon.
The in-app logo displays in color when its window is active and in grayscale when it is inactive.
Andromeda keeps the settings, history, and archives from earlier versions.
This is the first public release. Install it once from the public download to switch from an earlier private beta to the new update feed.

sections.title: Added
items: Organise a Folder can now preview and apply moves inside a selected cloud folder. The preview explains that moves can sync to your other devices.
History can put moved files back. Any folders created by the plan stay in place.
Online-only files are listed as needing a download before Andromeda can organise them.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Sidebar sizes stay aligned to the right when category names wrap.

sections.title: Added
items: Open **What’s New** from Settings or Sparkle’s Version History button to read release notes in Andromeda.
See total disk space for all matches in Scan a Folder, including results beyond the first page.
Undo a single move or remove an unchanged copy from History. Protect project folders from Move to Cloud suggestions.

sections.title: Improved
items: Folder scans continue when you switch pages. Storage Map prepares during Scan This Mac, keeps its results, and shows small items’ names and sizes on hover.
Overview separates the sum of file allocations from macOS used space and points to detected shared storage.
Settings has a curved sidebar, six visible categories, and neutral highlights. The main sidebar keeps long names readable, and first-run setup offers US or UK spelling.
Andromeda has a new folder icon and clearer labels for cloud and external archive tools.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Device Support and other unverified cleanup entries show **Report only** for the installed macOS version.

sections.title: Fixed
items: External Archives can verify copies and restore files when macOS adds its own provenance metadata to a new file or folder.

sections.title: Improved
items: What changed? puts the largest changes first and opens Space Plan from a folder you’ve added.
Cleanup review shows the exact target path and explains how to put files back from History.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Scan a Folder reads `/private/tmp` and `/tmp`.

sections.title: Improved
items: External Archives puts matching files first, names the drive to connect, and links to a verified restored file.
